;Law and crime
*[[Sexual abuse scandal in Southern Baptist churches]], [[Religious abuse]], [[Baptists in the United States]]
**An investigation by ''[[Houston Chronicle]]'' and the ''[[San Antonio Express-News]]'' found that since 1998, about 380 Southern Baptist church [[Clergy|clerics]], [[Laity|laypersons]], and [[Volunteering|volunteers]] have faced credible accusations of [[Sexual abuse|sexual abuse]] and that of those, roughly 220 were convicted of [[Sex and the law|sex crimes]] or received [[Plea bargain|plea deals]], in cases involving more than 700 victims. Many accusers were young men and women, who allegedly experienced everything from [[Sexual abuse|molestation]] to [[Rape|rape]] and [[Human fertilization|impregnation]] at the hands of church members. [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/investigations/article/Southern-Baptist-sexual-abuse-spreads-as-leaders-13588038.php (''Houston Chronicle'')] [https://projects.houstonchronicle.com/2019/southern-baptist-abuse/  (''Houston Chronicle''<sub>2</sub>)] [https://www.expressnews.com/news/investigations/article/Southern-Baptist-sexual-abuse-spreads-as-leaders-13588038.php (''San Antonio Express-News'')]
**President of the [[Southern Baptist Convention]] [[J. D. Greear]] condemns the sexual abuse committed by the [[Clergy|clergy]], [[Laity|laypersons]], and [[Volunteering|volunteers]] and calls it "pure [[Evil|evil]]". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/religion/2019/02/10/pure-evil-southern-baptist-leaders-condemn-decades-sexual-abuse-revealed-investigation/?noredirect=on&utm_term=.b7a520318d0e (''The Washington Post'')]
*Three people are killed in [[Gandhinagar]], [[India]], by a [[serial killer]]. The alleged killer, who is later identified as a [[eunuch]], remains at large. [https://ahmedabadmirror.indiatimes.com/ahmedabad/others/gnagar-terrorised-by-serial-killer-on-prowl/articleshow/67920922.cms (''Ahmedabad Mirror'')]

[https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/democratic-sen-amy-klobuchar-announces-run-president-n969796 (NBC News)]
*[[Demographics of Hungary]], [[Opposition to immigration]]
**[[Hungary|Hungary's]] [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] announces new tax and loan benefits for families as part of his government’s efforts to increase the birth rate in Hungary. The new measures include the expansion of a loan program for families with at least two children and waiving personal income tax for women raising at least four children. Orbán is one of the most outspoken critics of [[Immigration to Europe|immigration to Europe]] from the Middle East and Asia. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190210-hungarys-orban-vows-defence-christian-europe (France 24)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hungary-orban-benefits/orban-offers-financial-incentives-to-boost-hungarys-birth-rate-idUSKCN1PZ0I0 (Reuters)]
;Sports
*[[2019 Caribbean Series]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Toros de Herrera]] become the first Panamanian team since [[1950 Caribbean Series|1950]] to win the [[Caribbean Series]] as they defeat the [[Las Tunas (baseball)|Leñadores de Las Tunas]] of Cuba 3-1 in the final. [http://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/25969317/panama-team-wins-country-first-caribbean-series-1950 (Associated Press via ESPN)]
